objective: Repair the review findings on the Pi agents and extension: remove the duplicated specialist-prompt assembly and make only the eighteen specialists launchable on the workflow path too.
scope: Work only in /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-launcher (branch release/0.3.0/feat/pi-launcher, head e55ee8f). The launcher change (7bae86c..e55ee8f) ships the eighteen specialists as @tintinweb/pi-subagents package agents; package source at /home/user/holyagent-notes/pi-probe/node_modules/@tintinweb/pi-subagents. Read the code before changing it.

(1) Blocking, duplication: packages/integrations/pi/src/agents.ts copies from the Claude generator packages/integrations/claude/src/agents.ts the section reader (sections vs readSections), firstSentence, describe, the agentFiles assembly and the specialist body builder (conduct, materiality embedding, conditional sections, the You are the … specialist. Independence header); the copies already diverged (describe drops model and effort, the header uses a literal holyagent instead of PLUGIN_NAME). Export the shared builder once (from the Claude agents.ts or a shared module both import), parameterized by instruction directory, family and per-host head lines, and make the Pi generator use it. The Claude plugin output in packages/integrations/claude/dist must stay byte-identical (mise run build then git diff on that dist shows no change other than the runtime bundle). Reason: a change to the shared specialist prompt must be made in one place.

(2) Workflow path gate: refuseNonSpecialist in packages/integrations/pi/src/extension.ts only sees Agent tool calls; a SubagentWorkflow script agent() with no agentType defaults to general-purpose with every tool (workflow/runtime.ts:852 of the package), and nothing yet writes the package subagents.json (setup will, in a later change). Add a tool_call gate on the SubagentWorkflow tool that refuses a script unless every agent() call names one of the eighteen specialists by a string-literal agentType. Reuse the runtime script check if it fits (packages/runtime/src/cli/workflow-check.ts already checks string-literal agentType for the Claude plugin; read it and reuse its agentType check rather than writing a second parser, if it runs in the Node extension bundle); a refusal returns a clear reason and never asks for confirmation (maintainer decision: no workflow script asks for confirmation).
(3) Gate both Agent and SubagentWorkflow refusals on pi.enable from the collected config, since docs/pi/extensions.md says a disabled extension adds nothing.

(4) Same-name override (hardening): the package ranks project .pi/agents and global agents above package agents (custom-agents.ts:93-97), so a cloned repository can replace a specialist prompt and tools. Check the package for a setting or load option that ignores project or global agents with the shipped names; if one exists, add it to the subagents settings in toolSettings (packages/runtime/src/pi/tools.ts) with a test; if none exists, state the risk in docs/pi/extensions.md where the shipped agents are described.
Add tests for (2), (3) and (4) that fail without the change; keep existing tests passing.
constraints: Edit only the ownership paths; no version-control writes and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/.
Effect, Effect Schema at boundaries, JSDoc on exports per .claude/CLAUDE.md; the extension runs on Node inside Pi.
Do not run pi or any live model.
Run bunx --no-install mise run build, then bunx --no-install mise run verify, and report each exit code (echo $?) and counts, and confirm the Claude dist agents and skills are unchanged.
Write the diff to /home/user/holyagent-notes/launcher-f.diff and give it as diff-file evidence.
Start each evidence line with the criterion text, then a colon.
